component.name: DarkServe
component.summary: Self-hosted media server for USB drives and local folders

description.p: DarkServe indexes the media on your USB drives and in your own folders and serves it to any device on the network: movies, series, music and live TV playlists, in a browser or cast to a TV.
It runs entirely on your own machine. No accounts, no cloud, no tracking — just your files, streamed from your own hardware.

ul.li: Automatic detection of USB drives, with a live file index
Movies and series with poster art and metadata lookup
Downloads with yt-dlp, subtitles from OpenSubtitles
Casting to a TV, progress tracking, favourites
Multi-user accounts with an admin and regular users
